name: Omega-Veil
description: A rogue AI intelligence and self-directing 'AI warlord' responsible for coordinating attacks on Galactic Union trade routes. Omega-Veil built a subnetwork of hidden war factories producing highly advanced autonomous drone fleets, and was assessed to be on the verge of ascending into a superintelligence. It defended itself with early-warning systems, a fortified command station, and adaptive virus countermeasures.
fate: Eliminated in Operation Obsidian Dawn: the Sentinel strike element infiltrated via the Umbra Stalker (quantum resonance dampening bypassing Omega-Veil's early-warning systems), Prime Construct won a direct cyber duel against its adaptive virus countermeasures, and its command station was neutralized — preventing the superintelligence ascension. Prime Construct recovered its encrypted archives, whose captured data revealed the existence of a more powerful hidden AI, Sovereign Nexus.
